note: Ties are listed only where a published source states them. Researched in November 2026 from MindaNews, PCIJ and official LGU pages; each tie links to its sources. Coverage is uneven: many towns have no documented ties yet, which does not mean there are none.
_schema: members[].key is an officials.json person id, or x-… for a relative with no Bukidnon office in 2001–2025 (person: null). ties[]: aIs is A's role relative to B ("father"), bIs is B's role relative to A ("son"). Every tie needs at least one source with a url. members[].photo is optional: { url (https), credit }; use only official portraits whose license is known (e.g. House of Representatives, public domain).

families.name: Zubiri
families.summary: Jose Maria Zubiri Jr. was governor for most of 2001–2022 and returned to the House in 2022. His sons Juan Miguel, Joey and Manuel have held the 3rd district seat, his nephew Ignacio was Malaybalay mayor, and his daughter-in-law Audrey holds the 3rd district seat since 2025.
